title: Cleft sentences — It is ... that...
examples: It is the methodology that raises concern.
It was the data that convinced the panel.
It is clarity that audiences value most.
pattern: It is/was + emphasised element + that/who + clause
explanation: Cleft sentences highlight one piece of information by moving it into a focused It is... structure.
explanationIt: Le frasi cleft evidenziano un'informazione spostandola in una struttura focalizzata It is...
realUse: It is the quality of the evidence that determines the strength of the claim.
It was the premise that needed clarification.
It is the long-term impact that matters most.

options: It is the quality of the evidence that determines the claim.
It the quality of the evidence determines the claim.
Is it the quality that the evidence determines claim.
It are the quality of the evidence that determine the claim.
exercises.answer: It is the quality of the evidence that determines the claim.
exercises.explanation: Use It is + focused noun phrase + that + clause.

exercises.prompt: It ____ the lack of data that weakens the argument.
Fix: It was the results what convinced us.
options: It was the results that convinced us.
It was the results what convinced us.
It were the results that convinced us.
It the results was that convinced us.
exercises.answer: It was the results that convinced us.
